West Bengal's OBC Quota Law Amended Amid Assembly Passage

The West Bengal Assembly has passed twin bills amending the OBC quota law, which was introduced during Mamata Banerjee's tenure. The amendments remove 77 Muslim communities from the reservation list. This move exposes divisions within a rebel group in the ruling TMC party.
